verdict.rationale: Kick covers many items at once mainly through automation. Rules apply automatically to every matching transaction, AI categorization handles about 97% of synced transactions on the first pass, and MCP/CLI access lets an assistant execute bookkeeping changes and build workflows that run across every workspace. That implies bulk operations can be done through agents, but nothing documents a bulk-action capability as such. Missing for 10: a documented bulk select/edit/recategorize operation, MCP or CLI tools explicitly batching changes over many items, limits or approval behavior for batch changes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
